# 14 · The Old Ways
The unimproved world as a source; the counter-argument to industrialization, leaning
faith (spirits) or culture (the wild as muse). The 🌿 ladder shipped 2026-08-31.
Constraint: this theme's happiness (wild ground pays content) is part of the Order-gated
budget. Wins by: the quiet races — contentment, wild-ground counts, the Grove.

**Tech (neutral-tree ruling):** deliberately none — the Old Ways refuse the tree; every card of theirs arrives by faith or culture.

## Æra I
- Religion:
  - Spirits of the Wood — Clearing a forest or jungle pays +15 faith. +1 culture on every forest hex.
  - Winter Mother — +1 food on every tundra hex. +1 faith on every tundra hex that is wooded.
  - Desert Fathers — +1 faith on every desert hex.
  - Lady of the Hunt (shared with 02) — +1 food and +1 gold on every hex with a Camp improvement. Clearing a barbarian camp pays +10 faith.

## The proposal batch (2026-09-02 — safe · wild, over-provisioned; cut freely)
- Æra II · The Green Offering *(safe, rite)* — an augur rite that creates a standing stones improvement: +15 faith, and the hex pays +1 faith and +1 culture for each adjacent unimproved tile. standing stones does not count as an improved tile.
- Æra III · The Grove Court *(wild, Order, rare)* — great-person works may be planted on forest without clearing it, they count as unimproved tiles
- Æra III · The Long Fallow *(wild, Order — needs a memory the sim lacks)* — unimproved tiles gain +1 food and +1 faith for every 20 turns this order is slotted in the government
- Æra IV · The Green Cathedral *(wild — a sixth consecration)* — a cathedral may be consecrated to the Old Ways: unimproved hexes in its city pay +1 faith and +1 culture. (One data row in the consecration table; the machinery ships already.)
- Æra IV · The Untouched Vale *(safe, reckoning)* — at the close of the age, the empire working the most unimproved hexes.
